name: Re:quiem [Aster]
source:
The story of the failed "children" that rebelled against the Goddess of the Moon.

The setting is the Moon.

Since the disease "Flowerette", in which people and creatures suddenly become flowers, has become widespread, the earth has become a land of despair covered in green.

The few remaining humans try to move to the moon, but the fate of humankind lays in the hands of a woman who survives from Flowerette and is later talked about as a goddess.

She was supposed to save everything...

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
translation:
这是残缺的“孩子们”反抗月之女神的故事。

故事的舞台是月球。

一种名为“花化症”的疾病蔓延开来，人类和其他生物会突然变成花朵。地球就此化为一片绿意覆盖的绝望之地。

为数不多的幸存者试图移居月球。人类的命运，却掌握在一名从花化症中幸存、后来被世人尊为女神的女性手中。

她本该拯救一切…

[译自[url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]官方网站[/url]]
